crossRefs.note: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no present. But he…
Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: The people said to Samuel, “Who is he who said, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Bring those men, that we may put them to death!”
translations.bsb: Then the people said to Samuel, “Who said that Saul should not reign over us? Bring those men here so we can kill them!”
translations.kjv: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.
translations.asv: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.
